title: Shadow card morph
blurb: Compares expanding a <profile-card> custom element with shadowRoots: [card.shadowRoot] versus omitting the option, verifying captured pseudo-elements via document.getAnimations().
question: Does listing card.shadowRoot in document.startViewTransition() capture avatar and title names declared inside the component's shadow stylesheet alongside a light-DOM caption?
result: Light-DOM card-caption is captured everywhere; shadow-declared card-avatar and card-name join only when ViewTransitionShadowRoots is active and the root is listed (not verified in Chrome 160).
testedIn: Chrome 153 / Chromium 157 (flag inactive); not verified in Chrome 160
